items.title: Charaka Samhita
items.author: Agnivesha; revised by Charaka, completed by Dridhabala
items.contribution: Internal medicine: causes, diagnosis and treatment of most diseases; daily routine; Rasayana

items.title: Sushruta Samhita
items.author: Sushruta
items.contribution: Surgery, anatomy, Kshara Sutra, eye and ENT, stones, fistula

items.title: Ashtanga Hridaya
items.author: Vagbhata
items.contribution: Concise synthesis of Charaka and Sushruta; daily and seasonal routine

items.title: Ashtanga Sangraha
items.author: Vriddha Vagbhata
items.contribution: Larger companion to Ashtanga Hridaya; expanded treatments

items.title: Agnivesha Tantra
items.author: Agnivesha (pupil of Atreya)
items.contribution: Survives only as the Charaka Samhita, which revised it

items.title: Bhela Samhita
items.author: Bhela (pupil of Atreya)
items.contribution: Parallel Atreya-school text; survives incomplete in one manuscript

items.title: Harita Samhita
items.author: Attributed to Harita
items.contribution: General medicine; women's and children's health

items.title: Kashyapa Samhita
items.author: Kashyapa; redacted by Vatsya
items.contribution: Paediatrics (Kaumarabhritya), women's health, Amlapitta

items.title: Madhava Nidana
items.author: Madhavakara
items.contribution: Standard text on causes, types and symptoms of every disease

items.title: Vrinda Madhava (Siddhayoga)
items.author: Vrinda
items.contribution: Treatments arranged in Madhava Nidana's order

items.title: Chikitsa Kalika
items.author: Tisata
items.contribution: Concise treatment manual

items.title: Chakradatta
items.author: Chakrapanidatta
items.contribution: Standard treatment compendium; Amavata and many formulas

items.title: Vangasena Samhita
items.author: Vangasena
items.contribution: Treatment compendium from Bengal

items.title: Gadanigraha
items.author: Shodhala
items.contribution: Formulas and new diseases such as Katigraha (low back pain)

items.title: Sharangadhara Samhita
items.author: Sharangadhara
items.contribution: Pharmaceutics: how to make powders, decoctions, ghee, oils; pulse diagnosis

items.title: Bhavaprakasha
items.author: Bhavamishra
items.contribution: Comprehensive text; new diseases and New World plants

items.title: Yogaratnakara
items.author: Anonymous (Maharashtra)
items.contribution: Popular formulary and diagnosis

items.title: Bhaishajya Ratnavali
items.author: Govinda Das Sen
items.contribution: Large formulary; source of many modern classical medicines

items.title: Basavarajiyam
items.author: Basavaraja (Andhra region)
items.contribution: Telugu-Sanskrit handbook; pulse diagnosis and mineral medicines

items.title: Sahasrayogam
items.author: Kerala tradition (compiler unknown)
items.contribution: Kerala formulary: Kashayams like Rasnasaptakam, Kokilaksham, oils

items.title: Dhanvantari Nighantu
items.author: Attributed to Dhanvantari
items.contribution: Names and properties of medicinal plants

items.title: Shodhala Nighantu
items.author: Shodhala
items.contribution: Herb names and properties

items.title: Madanapala Nighantu
items.author: Madanapala
items.contribution: Herbs, foods and their properties

items.title: Kaiyadeva Nighantu
items.author: Kaiyadeva
items.contribution: Herbs and diet (Pathyapathya)

items.title: Raja Nighantu
items.author: Narahari Pandita
items.contribution: Extensive herb synonyms and properties

items.title: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu
items.author: Bhavamishra
items.contribution: The most widely used herb dictionary today

items.title: Abhidhana Manjari
items.author: Kerala scholar
items.contribution: Kerala herb names

items.title: Priya Nighantu
items.author: P. V. Sharma
items.contribution: Modern Nighantu

items.title: Rasarnava
items.author: Anonymous
items.contribution: Early alchemy: mercury processing

items.title: Rasendra Chudamani
items.author: Somadeva
items.contribution: Mineral medicines and processing

items.title: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya
items.author: Vagbhata (Rasa)
items.contribution: Standard Rasa Shastra text: purification of metals and minerals

items.title: Rasa Prakasha Sudhakara
items.author: Yashodhara
items.contribution: Mineral processing

items.title: Rasaratnakara
items.author: Nityanatha Siddha
items.contribution: Mineral formulas

items.title: Rasendra Sara Sangraha
items.author: Gopala Krishna
items.contribution: Popular herbo-mineral formulary

items.title: Ayurveda Prakasha
items.author: Madhava Upadhyaya
items.contribution: Mineral processing and formulas

items.title: Rasa Tarangini
items.author: Sadananda Sharma
items.contribution: Modern standard text on mineral medicines and their purification

items.title: Rigveda
items.author: Vedic seers
items.contribution: Oshadhi Sukta (hymn to healing plants); the Ashvins as physicians

items.title: Atharvaveda
items.author: Vedic seers
items.contribution: Earliest healing hymns and plant medicine; Ayurveda is called its Upaveda

items.title: Taittiriya Upanishad
items.author: Vedic
items.contribution: The five sheaths (Pancha Kosha): body, breath, mind, intellect, bliss

items.title: Prashna Upanishad
items.author: Vedic
items.contribution: Prana and its divisions, basis of the five Vayus

items.title: Samkhya Karika
items.author: Ishvarakrishna
items.contribution: The 25 principles (tattvas) behind Ayurveda's theory of matter and mind

items.title: Yoga Sutras
items.author: Patanjali
items.contribution: Mind, meditation and the eight limbs of yoga

items.title: Hatha Yoga Pradipika
items.author: Svatmarama
items.contribution: Asanas, pranayama and six cleansing practices (Shatkarma)

items.title: Gheranda Samhita
items.author: Gheranda
items.contribution: Cleansing practices, asanas, mudras, pranayama
